policy: Review every closed candidate set. Select only when ASV wording or an explicit mapped textual note distinguishes a reading; otherwise mark underdetermined and retain the base fallback. The base candidate is the SBLGNT reading.

decisions.evidence: ASV 'And he answered and said unto them' names no subject; the added ὁ Ἰησοῦς would surface as 'Jesus answered'. The bare participle is what the English renders.
ASV 'because they have suffered these things' renders ταῦτα; τοιαῦτα would give 'such things'. The demonstrative without the qualitative force distinguishes the base.
ὁμοίως and ὡσαύτως are English synonyms; ASV 'in like manner' translates either equally. No note. Judged from this verse alone, underdetermined.
δεκαοκτώ and the analytic δέκα καὶ ὀκτώ are the same numeral; ASV 'eighteen' cannot register the written form. Underdetermined.

ASV 'think ye that they were offenders' uses a plain personal pronoun; the demonstrative οὗτοι would give 'these' as it does for 'those eighteen' earlier in the verse. The pronoun distinguishes αὐτοί.
Presence or absence of the article before the participle; ASV 'all the men that dwell in Jerusalem' needs its English article either way. Underdetermined.
κατοικοῦντας with the accusative object already means 'dwell in Jerusalem'; the added ἐν leaves no separate English reflex in ASV's 'that dwell in Jerusalem'. Underdetermined.
Present vs aorist subjunctive of μετανοέω; ASV 'except ye repent' carries no aspect. Underdetermined.
ὡσαύτως and ὁμοίως are English synonyms; ASV 'likewise' translates either. No note. Underdetermined.

Placement of πεφυτευμένην relative to ἐν τῷ ἀμπελῶνι αὐτοῦ only; English requires 'a fig tree planted in his vineyard' under either order, and the base and r01 differ solely in punctuation. Underdetermined.

ASV 'Behold, these three years I come seeking fruit' is the idiomatic English for the span with or without ἀφ᾽ οὗ; the deictic 'these' can carry the 'since' relation, so the omission is not excluded and the base is not confirmed. Underdetermined.
ASV 'cut it down' has no inferential connective; the added οὖν would surface as 'therefore', which ASV supplies elsewhere when it is present. The bare imperative distinguishes the base.

ASV joins 'thenceforth' to the fruit-bearing clause ('if it bear fruit thenceforth, well; but if not, thou shalt cut it down'), which excludes RP's order attaching εἰς τὸ μέλλον to the cutting. Base and r01 are the same wording, differing only in punctuation, so the English cannot choose between them.
Added copula ἦν; ASV 'a woman that had a spirit of infirmity' supplies English verbs either way and leaves no reflex of the Greek copula. Underdetermined.
Same numeral written two ways; ASV 'eighteen years' cannot register it. Underdetermined.
ASV states the cause explicitly, 'being moved with indignation because Jesus had healed on the sabbath'; 'because' renders ὅτι, which the omitting reading lacks.
ASV 'in them therefore come and be healed' renders the personal pronoun αὐταῖς; ταύταις would give 'in these' or 'in these days'.
ASV opens 'But the Lord answered him' — an adversative rendering δέ; οὖν would give 'therefore', as ASV renders it in v. 18.
Aorist ἀπαγαγών vs present ἀπάγων; ASV 'and lead him away to watering' coordinates the participle without marking aspect. Underdetermined.
ASV 'He said therefore' renders the inferential οὖν; δέ would give 'and' or 'but'.
ASV 'and became a tree' has no adjective; the added μέγα would surface as 'a great tree'.
ASV 'And again he said' renders the initial καί, which the omitting reading lacks.

Simplex ἔκρυψεν vs compound ἐνέκρυψεν; ASV 'hid in three measures of meal' states the location from the prepositional phrase either way. The note is a cross-reference to Mt. 13:33 on the measure, not a variant. Underdetermined.
Two spellings of the city name; ASV 'Jerusalem' renders both. Underdetermined.
ASV 'enter in by the narrow door' renders θύρα; πύλη is a gate and ASV distinguishes the two words. The mapped note is an alternative_rendering on 'able, when once' and does not bear on this unit.
ASV has the single vocative 'Lord, open to us'; the doubled κύριε κύριε would give 'Lord, Lord'.
ASV 'and he shall say, I tell you, I know not whence ye are' renders a first-person finite Λέγω ὑμῖν; the participle λέγων would give 'saying unto you'.
ASV 'I know not whence ye are' has no object pronoun; the added ὑμᾶς would give 'I know you not', which ASV writes where it stands.
Presence of the articles in οἱ ἐργάται τῆς ἀδικίας; ASV 'all ye workers of iniquity' cannot register Greek articles here. Underdetermined.
Aorist subjunctive ὄψησθε vs future ὄψεσθε after ὅταν; ASV 'when ye shall see' renders either. Underdetermined.
ASV repeats the preposition, 'from the east and west, and from the north and south'; the second 'from' renders ἀπό, which the omitting reading lacks.
ASV 'In that very hour' renders ὥρᾳ; ἡμέρᾳ would give 'day'.
ἀποτελῶ and ἐπιτελῶ both mean to complete or perform; ASV 'perform cures' renders either. The note 'Or, end my course' attaches to τελειοῦμαι later in the verse, not to this verb. Underdetermined.
ASV 'your house is left unto you desolate' renders ἔρημος, which the base lacks.
ASV connects the clause, 'and I say unto you'; the connective renders δέ, absent from the omitting reading, which would leave asyndeton.
Recitative ὅτι before direct speech is not rendered in English; ASV 'I say unto you, Ye shall not see me' reads the same either way. Underdetermined.
Word order of ἴδητέ με only; ASV 'Ye shall not see me' requires English order regardless. Underdetermined.
ASV reads simply 'until ye shall say, Blessed is he that cometh'; ἥξει ὅτε would surface as 'until the time come when ye shall say', and RP's ἄν likewise. The omission is what the English renders.
